What we do

Five services, one team. Pick what you need and tap through for details.

“At G-I-MWORLD, we believe that great experiences begin with creativity, good food, attention to detail, and a commitment to customer satisfaction.”

G-I-MWORLD is a growing Nigerian business based in Moniya, Ibadan. We combine creativity, hospitality, food, grilling, event decoration, and digital services, with the goal of providing dependable services to individuals, families, event planners, businesses, churches, and organizations.

    How to pay

    You pay by bank transfer to our OPay or PalmPay account, after we confirm your order and total.

    1. OrderPlace your order or request a quote on WhatsApp.
    2. ConfirmWe confirm availability, your total and any delivery charge.
    3. PayTransfer to the account below. Check the account name first.
    4. Send proofSend your payment screenshot on WhatsApp.
    5. DoneWe confirm your payment and order with you directly.

    This website does not take card details, PINs or passwords, and it does not confirm payments. Your order is confirmed only after G-I-MWORLD replies to you directly. Pay only to the account names shown here, and never share your PIN or OTP with anyone. Delivery charges are separate.
